process.title: Discover
process.text: Tell us what matters — budget, commute, schools, timelines. We come back with a shortlist of five, not fifty.

process.title: Visit
process.text: Chauffeured site visits, or live video walkthroughs at hours that suit you in Dubai or Denver.

process.title: Verify
process.text: Our in-house legal team runs a 40-point check on title, approvals, khata, EC and RERA before you commit a rupee.

process.title: Own
process.text: Loan, agreement, registration, possession and — if you want it — property management. One team, start to finish.

faqs.q: Do you charge buyers a fee?
faqs.a: For new launches there is no fee to buyers. For resale purchases we charge 1% of the transaction value plus GST, agreed in writing before we start.

faqs.q: Are the new projects you list RERA-registered?
faqs.a: Yes. We only list new projects that are registered with Karnataka RERA, and we give you the registration number so you can verify it on the Karnataka RERA portal. Propstep is itself a RERA-registered real estate agent.

faqs.q: Can I buy without visiting in person?
faqs.a: Yes — around a third of our buyers do. The NRI Desk runs live video walkthroughs, couriers documents, and can guide you through a power of attorney so a family member or our legal team can complete registration on your behalf.

faqs.q: How do you verify resale listings?
faqs.a: Before a resale home appears on our site we check ownership documents, the encumbrance certificate, khata status and building approvals, and an advisor visits the property in person. Listings that pass carry a 'Verified' badge.
We are currently active in Bengaluru, where we list and advise on verified properties. We are expanding across India as we grow, so more cities will follow.
